doc: Registry for in-test golden values (S4b). These literals live in test sources (NOT under tests/golden/) and are exempt from the S4b.0 off-golden-literal lint via this registry (allowlist with reason, same mechanism as score_sheet.md). The frozen slot bitmap (tests/golden/, d66faabf) is a different domain owned by update_goldens.py + lint_golden_pin.py and is untouched by every entry here.

in_test.pins: tests/golden/s6_3_reference_report.txt exact AnalysisReport for tests/fixtures/ref_happy_c_major.mid (tonic 60/major/conf 1.0, chords 60:maj + 65:maj, density 4.0, drums 2, bars 2, tpb 480) — GOLDEN class (run-captured on the clean tree; Release+Debug identical). Fixture generator tools/gen_s6_3_fixtures.py.
in_test.how: ctest -R 's6.3' (build-full Release or build-off Debug); values read from the INFO dump on the clean tree per the test-header capture procedure

in_test.test: s6.3 reference-import error paths + adopt gates (tests/test_s6_3_reference_import.cpp, [s6_3][reference])
in_test.pins: exact SmfError per corrupt fixture (Truncated/BadHeader/UnsupportedType/BadEvent) + verbatim Editor hint/status TEXT (unreadable / file-is-truncated / not-a-supported-MIDI-header / format-not-supported / corrupt-MIDI-events / too-little) + adopt-gate truth table — pinned as in-test string literals mirroring PluginEditor.cpp:1016/1025-1026/1034-1035/1080. JUCE->std adaptation: TEXT is the observable; RAW compare impossible by design.

in_test.test: s4b Creative arm adds weak-beat chromatic passing tones (tests/test_s4b_mode_shape.cpp, [modes][s4b])
in_test.pins: G1 exact passing-tone (tick,pitch) list kTones (4 pairs) — GOLDEN class (run-captured; arm is rng-free deterministic, values captured from a run). Structural CHECKs in the same case (counts, 16th-grid, duration 120, velocity 70, semitone approach, selectivity skips) are NOT goldens.
in_test.how: ctest -R 's4b Creative' (build-off Debug or build-full Release, identical — no sampler/model in path); values read from INFO 'tones (tick,pitch)' dump on the clean tree

in_test.test: s4b Experimental arm flips weak-beat color tones at ~25pc (tests/test_s4b_mode_shape.cpp, [modes][s4b])
in_test.pins: G2 exact flip list kFlips (tick:old->new, rng seed 9 pinned in-test (re-pinned under task-2; seed 7 is vacuous under Pcg32)) — GOLDEN class (run-captured, seed-dependent). Per-flip properties (weak beat, color degree, -1, Melody-only) + selectivity controls are NOT goldens.
in_test.how: ctest -R 's4b Experimental arm flips' ; values read from INFO 'flips (tick:old->new)' dump on the clean tree
in_test.recapture_reason: candidates RNG mt19937->Pcg32 moved the stream; seed re-pinned 7->9 (nearest seed >= 7 with a non-vacuous flip set; seed 7 is empty under Pcg32). New kFlips {(720,69,68),(1080,71,70)} run-captured + threshold-flip (25->75) red-proof; G1/G3 values unchanged (rng-free).

in_test.test: s4b Experimental arm keeps parallel-union pitches (tests/test_s4b_mode_shape.cpp, [modes][s4b])
in_test.pins: G3 exact kept-probe list kKept (3 pairs) — GOLDEN class (deterministic rng-free union snap, run-verified). Union-membership property + Strict-moves foil are NOT goldens.
in_test.how: ctest -R 's4b Experimental arm keeps' ; values read from INFO 'probes (tick,pitch)' dump on the clean tree

in_test.test: s4b sampler index-seed binding is pinned per candidate (tests/test_s4b_seed_binding.cpp, [sampler][s4b])
in_test.pins: kPinned[3][4] per-index FNV-1a hashes (64-hex digests) for seeds 0/10/11 — GOLDEN class (run-captured; recaptured clean at seed-0 fix-forward, seeds 10/11 banked after per-seed swap-sensitivity proof). Determinism/engagement/sensitivity preconditions are NOT goldens.
in_test.how: ctest -R 's4b sampler index-seed' (build-full Release, engaged path); values read from failure-diff / INFO dump on the clean tree, double-confirmed; swap red-proof per seed in task reports
in_test.recapture_reason: candidates RNG mt19937->Pcg32 moved every stream; all 12 hashes re-banked. Swap (sseed index->(index+1)%4) red-proof on the new streams: 11/12 redden, survivor seed-0 row-3 (same swap-invariance character as A1). New coincidence pattern: seed-10 rows 0+2 reuse seed-0 row-0 bytes.
